"""Intent tests for risk.log_returns (RISK-01, TC-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import Prices
from risk import Returns, log_returns


def as_prices(payload: dict) -> Prices:
    return Prices(
        dates=tuple(payload["dates"]),
        tickers=tuple(payload["tickers"]),
        closes={t: tuple(v) for t, v in payload["closes"].items()},
    )


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc04_geometric_closes_give_closed_form_returns(golden):
    given, expected = golden("risk", "TC-04")
    result = log_returns(as_prices(given["prices"]))
    assert isinstance(result, Returns)
    assert result.base_date == expected["base_date"]
    assert result.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert result.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(result.values) == set(expected["values"])
    for ticker, values in expected["values"].items():
        assert result.values[ticker] == pytest.approx(values, abs=expected["tol"], rel=0)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_contract_sample_prices_give_sample_returns(contract_sample):
    prices = as_prices(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))
    expected = contract_sample("risk.Returns")
    result = log_returns(prices)
    assert result.base_date == prices.dates[0]
    assert result.dates == prices.dates[1:]
    assert result.tickers == prices.tickers
    for ticker, values in expected["values"].items():
        assert len(result.values[ticker]) == len(prices.dates) - 1
        assert result.values[ticker] == pytest.approx(values, abs=1e-12, rel=0)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_fewer_than_two_dates_raises_value_error(contract_sample):
    payload = contract_sample("mdata.Prices")
    one_date = Prices(
        dates=tuple(payload["dates"][:1]),
        tickers=tuple(payload["tickers"]),
        closes={t: tuple(v[:1]) for t, v in payload["closes"].items()},
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)date"):
        log_returns(one_date)

def test_contract_sample_prices_give_sample_returns(contract_sample):
